description: This is a Python source file implementing a conversational bot with tools for weather, conversation saving/loading, image retrieval, and integration with speech and language services. It defines functions, classes, and event handlers for managing a WebRTC-based interactive AI system.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api
methods.description: Fetches weather data based on format and calls the result callback with weather info.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Requests an image frame based on user question and updates the context.

methods.name: get_saved_conversation_filenames
methods.description: Retrieves list of saved conversation filenames matching a pattern.

methods.name: save_conversation
methods.description: Saves current conversation messages to a timestamped JSON file.

methods.name: load_conversation
methods.description: Loads conversation messages from a specified JSON file.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Initializes and runs the conversational pipeline with event handlers.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point that creates transport and starts the bot.
